description:
Add a class-level comment to CacheCoordinator#fetch documenting the lookup order:
  1. CacheManager (config-backed on_load + its own memory cache)
  2. Coordinator's memory cache (fallback if CacheManager has none)

This documents the existing behavior so callers understand the two-tier cache. Already implemented in the working tree (uncommitted).

File: src/vug/cache_coordinator.cr
title: docs: document CacheCoordinator#fetch lookup order
